title: Supporting the designation of the week of September 14 through September 18, 2026, as "National Clean Energy Week".
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
